description.value: Signal in the Wreckage: Objective: board the powerless tug. Tow it or seal its reactor; delay costs the safe docking window.
Quarantine at Sunforge: Objective: obtain medicine clearance. Inspect the hold or call a civilian hearing; delay worsens the workers' exposure.
The Unlit Beacon: Objective: find the caller. Trace the signal or recover erased logs; delay activates the prediction loop.
The Fuel Bargain: Objective: secure rescue cells. Trade salvage rights or expose the diversion; delay triggers the auction.
Contradictory Orders: Objective: stop the blockade escalating. Compare signed directives or protect the neutral clerk; delay brings the cruiser.
Mirror Crossing: Objective: find the return corridor. Use silence or anchor a beacon; delay releases an echo stalker.
A Cable Under Fire: Objective: evacuate families. Hold off corsairs or rig a second towline; delay separates the rescue convoy.
Witness at the Ring: Objective: preserve testimony. Escort the clerk or broadcast the original seal; delay allows its seizure.
The Names Beneath: Objective: recover missing people. Restore name plates or negotiate with the sentinel; delay erases another record.
The Civilian Tow: Objective: save the relay. Share reserve power or persuade Ferry Nine to assist; delay destroys docking clamps.
The Reactor Ward: Objective: deliver treatment. Bargain with security or enter the maintenance shaft; delay quarantines the medical team.
A Weapon in the Lens: Objective: separate rescue knowledge from targeting data. Isolate the link or confront its researcher; delay publishes the coordinates.
The Last Passenger: Objective: protect the last evacuation. Board the captain's tug or reroute the corsairs; delay sacrifices the chart.
The Open Tribunal: Objective: decide the treaty's fate. Present evidence or negotiate amnesty; delay lets the admiral close proceedings.
The Caretaker's Price: Objective: secure a safe return. Trade a memory or rewrite the beacon contract; delay traps the expedition.
A Route for Everyone: Objective: settle ownership. Sign a habitat deed or create a courier cooperative; record who pays for repairs.
A Quarantine Lifted: Objective: settle responsibility. Demand reparations or accept a protected confession; record who can enter the docks.
Tomorrow Changed: Objective: choose the experiment's future. Preserve an open archive or dismantle prediction; record who keeps the recovered names.
Relief Signal: the tug broadcasts for help as its captain refuses to abandon passengers.
Sealed Shipment: the inspector holds medicine while an envoy offers a private waiver.
Future Distress: a beacon broadcasts a casualty list containing one crew member.
Fuel Auction: the broker opens bidding for cells already promised to rescue volunteers.
Order Collision: two patrols arrive with opposing instructions and demand the crew choose.
Missing Arrival: a gate sensor records a ship that nobody can see.
Air Ration: families ask the crew to witness an evacuation lottery.
Worker Collapse: a foundry medic exposes contamination before security seals the ward.
Names Return: the archive announces people erased from every station register.
Cable Rupture: a rescue route breaks while the ferry crew debates turning back.
Public Hearing: the clerk requests a neutral witness before reading the original manifest.
Silent Pursuit: an echo stalker repeats the expedition's last movement.
Courier Offer: a messenger proposes a safe route in exchange for permanent public access.
Embassy Siege: the defector seeks shelter as patrols surround the embassy.
Lens Alignment: an observation window reveals the beacon weapon link.
Tug Drift: the powerless vessel moves toward a crowded habitat.
Treatment Deadline: the medicine loses potency before the tribunal resumes.
Second Voice: a hidden signal asks the crew to rescue a memory rather than a body.
Salvage Claim: corsairs offer assistance if every rescued ship becomes their property.
Union Vote: dock workers vote to reopen if their exposure readings enter the public record.
Gate Warning: a probe sends a map of a return corridor that has not yet formed.
Reserve Choice: the engineer can save the relay by exhausting a small habitat's cells.
Cruiser Arrival: the admiral suspends negotiations until neutral observers inspect the hold.
Archive Leak: a targeting faction offers to purchase the recovered rescue data.
Towline Stand: volunteers cross under attack while the captain asks who should go last.
Treaty Broadcast: the envoy gives the crew a one-use channel to every member world.
Memory Bargain: the warden asks one traveler to surrender a personal memory.
New Route: survivors propose community ownership of the rescue corridor.
Open Docks: the assembly demands compensation for everyone denied treatment.
Beacon Rewritten: a final transmission reflects the crew's decision about the experiment.
